assets.caption: FIGURE 6 GAS TURBINE COMPRESSED FUEL GAS SUPPLY SYSTEM WITH VAPORISED LPG BACK-UP
assets.notes: Full-page P&ID/flow diagram of gas turbine compressed fuel gas supply system with vaporised LPG back-up. Includes superheater, filter/separator, buffer K.O. vessel, compressor, cooler, compressor suction/K.O. vessel, LPG vaporiser, and associated instrumentation and control loops. Notes panel visible on right side of diagram.
